profile.headline: React Developer
profile.summary: Full-stack software developer who specializes in TypeScript & Next.js

positions.title: Computer Support Specialist
positions.description:
- Developed internal tools used daily by IT, including a real-time technician status tracker built as a Turbo monorepo with a Next.js PWA and React Native iOS client backed by self-hosted Convex
- Built a desktop search utility with a coworker enabling technicians to find and remotely connect to any workstation by name, email, extension, or hostname
- Wrote scripts and automation to streamline recurring workflows across a 500+ user municipal environment
- Provided tier 1–3 support and deployed Cisco Meraki switches, wireless APs, and rack-mounted servers
positions.insights: Computer Hardware Troubleshooting, Computer Networking and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Replaced a legacy Microsoft Access system storing sensitive data in plaintext with a modern web application built on Next.js, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, and Auth.js with Microsoft Entra ID
- Designed and normalized the database schema across three campus locations, migrating student records, enrollment, payments, and scheduling into PostgreSQL
- Built complex multi-step forms for registration, grading, payment processing, and lead tracking with auto-fill and real-time Zod validation
- Deployed the application and database to on-site infrastructure accessible across all locations via WireGuard VPN

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description: Supported district-wide technology infrastructure for staff and students including hardware repair, device management, and secure testing environments
positions.insights: Computer Hardware, Computer Networking and +2 skills

projects.title: Convex Monorepo
projects.description: Production Turbo boilerplate with self-hosted Convex, Next.js, and an Expo application. Docker deployment, multi-provider auth including custom useSend email provider, already set up with Sentry and Plausible. Live at https://convexmonorepo.gbrown.org

projects.title: Tech Tracker
projects.description: Turbo monorepo with Next.js PWA and Expo React Native app sharing a self-hosted Convex backend. Real-time updates across all clients, cron-scheduled status changes, user profiles with many settings & automations, Convex Auth with Entra ID, & self-hosted Sentry integration with session replay.
